body:
He made several racist remarks about me being jewish. Such as he is going to gas me and send me to a camp to be killed. He also called me a N*gger and told me I was autistic. I have no proof but 3 mods were in the room which were GrapeSmoothie, Cyanide, Steven5703 and Flo. Also GH0ST4949 was there and testified to them. He also called the mods bias and made fun of Flo being German. And Michael said he was going to hit me offline and "gas" my internet. I know i have no proof but ask those 4 mods and 1 user. 5 witness against none on michael's side. I want an apology from him or please ban him from teamspeak or mute him on teamspeak. I feel horrible now and no one should be disrespected like I was. 


Thank you and please take care of this problem
